notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.48 and later; returns the IP address of the user who most recently logged in using the selected account context. No request arguments or defaults are declared in the pinned operation.
The pinned payload is a list of strings. Preserve list order, duplicates and an empty list; do not infer nullable values or perform IP normalization. A missing data member is a payload mismatch.

The original security-access capture on cPanel 11.138.0.19 returned a scalar string through both routes. The result preserves that string or the documented list of strings without wrapping, address validation or normalization. Empty strings and exact spelling remain unchanged; null and absent data remain invalid. Masked evidence does not reveal the returned address or establish every string format.

evidence.note: Original immutable docs/api/evidence/2026-10-31-security-access.json (SHA-256 4697e246b36b465efa814273d583d2c50c72d795352f3205eba0d983ac14ea77), captured at revision 91fce03c2cc0e24893d9c269b51a2c7d02644f0b on cPanel 11.138.0.19 from pinned source SHA-256 172660ce0d8e0868756dabf8e3243ea41399aac7bff06082d806c73f71a094fc, records HTTP 200 and API success on direct-uapi and bridged-uapi GET routes. LastLogin/get_last_or_current_logged_in_ip payload root $ has string type and the original type_mismatch finding under effective contract ef81136486e5b6037406dc0413335851014b7a60ea1af90f9642631cf6035b82, while the pinned formal schema declares list<string>. Preserve both contracts using only string|list<string> at the payload root. Preserve exact strings and list entries without address normalization, parsing or scalar wrapping; no integer, float, boolean, object, null or absent-payload coercion is inferred. The evidence masks string values and establishes no address format. Preserve the original failed artifact unchanged.
